$comment: antd Tag call sites still to migrate. One entry per file — the debt is a whole-file import. Delete an entry in the same commit that migrates its file; a stale entry fails the guard, both directions. Scope note, deliberately narrow: this list counts antd <Tag> imports only. Hand-written chip/pill/badge class names are NOT counted here, because a class name does not say whether it is a settled status word — it is equally likely to be a count badge, a category label or a type annotation. Counting those here would seed the list with entries nobody can ever migrate, and a list that cannot shrink gets switched off. Those sites are decided one by one from the mapping doc.
